Systematic Investment Plan (SIP)

Moderate Risk

A disciplined strategy where you invest a fixed amount regularly (monthly or weekly) into mutual funds or index funds instead of a lump sum.

Key Financial Benefits:

  • ✔ Rupee Cost Averaging: Automatically purchases more fund units when prices fall and fewer when markets peak.
  • ✔ Unstoppable Compounding: Reinvests gains steadily over 5 to 25+ years to generate massive exponential returns.
  • ✔ Discipline & Stress-Free: Eliminates the emotional anxiety of attempting to time volatile market peaks and valleys.
